YC

2026-07-08

Figure 1. AUC comparison

model_perf <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Elastic-net", "Random Forest", "Radial SVM"),
  AUC = c(0.993, 0.990, 0.991),
  Accuracy = c(0.967, 0.958, 0.975),
  Sensitivity = c(0.942, 0.942, 0.968),
  Specificity = c(0.986, 0.970, 0.980),
  Balanced_Accuracy = c(0.964, 0.956, 0.974)
)

model_perf
##           Model   AUC Accuracy Sensitivity Specificity Balanced_Accuracy
## 1   Elastic-net 0.993    0.967       0.942       0.986             0.964
## 2 Random Forest 0.990    0.958       0.942       0.970             0.956
## 3    Radial SVM 0.991    0.975       0.968       0.980             0.974
p_auc <- ggplot(model_perf, aes(x = Model, y = AUC)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", AUC)),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 5
  ) +
  ylim(0.95, 1.00) +
  labs(
    title = "AUC comparison of ML models",
    x = NULL,
    y = "AUC"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)
  )

p_auc

ggsave(
  filename = "Figure1_AUC_comparison.png",
  plot = p_auc,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

Figure 2. Accuracy and balanced accuracy comparison

accuracy_df <- model_perf %>%
  select(Model, Accuracy, Balanced_Accuracy) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Accuracy, Balanced_Accuracy),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

accuracy_df$Metric <- factor(
  accuracy_df$Metric,
  levels = c("Accuracy", "Balanced_Accuracy"),
  labels = c("Accuracy", "Balanced accuracy")
)

p_accuracy <- ggplot(accuracy_df, aes(x = Model, y = Value, fill = Metric)) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.65
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", Value)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  ylim(0.90, 1.00) +
  labs(
    title = "Accuracy and balanced accuracy of ML models",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Performance",
    fill = "Metric"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

p_accuracy

ggsave(
  filename = "Figure2_Accuracy_BalancedAccuracy_comparison.png",
  plot = p_accuracy,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

Figure 3. Sensitivity and specificity comparison

sens_spec_df <- model_perf %>%
  select(Model, Sensitivity, Specificity) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Sensitivity, Specificity),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

p_sens_spec <- ggplot(sens_spec_df, aes(x = Model, y = Value, fill = Metric)) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.65
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", Value)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  ylim(0.90, 1.00) +
  labs(
    title = "Sensitivity and specificity of ML models",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Performance",
    fill = "Metric"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

p_sens_spec

ggsave(
  filename = "Figure3_Sensitivity_Specificity_comparison.png",
  plot = p_sens_spec,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

Interpretation

best_auc <- model_perf$Model[which.max(model_perf$AUC)]
best_accuracy <- model_perf$Model[which.max(model_perf$Accuracy)]
best_sensitivity <- model_perf$Model[which.max(model_perf$Sensitivity)]
best_specificity <- model_perf$Model[which.max(model_perf$Specificity)]
best_balanced_accuracy <- model_perf$Model[which.max(model_perf$Balanced_Accuracy)]

summary_df <- data.frame(
  Criterion = c(
    "Highest AUC",
    "Highest accuracy",
    "Highest sensitivity",
    "Highest specificity",
    "Highest balanced accuracy"
  ),
  Best_Model = c(
    best_auc,
    best_accuracy,
    best_sensitivity,
    best_specificity,
    best_balanced_accuracy
  )
)

summary_df
##                   Criterion  Best_Model
## 1               Highest AUC Elastic-net
## 2          Highest accuracy  Radial SVM
## 3       Highest sensitivity  Radial SVM
## 4       Highest specificity Elastic-net
## 5 Highest balanced accuracy  Radial SVM
